messages.subject: 1-1-1 mediation model, no warnings, degree of -1, no p-value showing NA?
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to run a 1-1-1 model to analyse the within and between family effect using twin study, please see the follwing of mu codes, however, somehow the model results didn't show any p-values and also z-values. 

How could I deal with it?

Thank you so much for any help!

Quan 

### specifying the 1-1-1 mdel
withinnc_chol_cog_noncog_corrected_FRC_1_year12_child_feelingdisciplinechaos1_lt3a1 <- "
 
 level: 1
 lt3a1~e*year12_child_feelingdisciplinechaos1+f*nc_chol_cog_noncog_corrected_FRC_1
 
 year12_child_feelingdisciplinechaos1~d*nc_chol_cog_noncog_corrected_FRC_1
 
 level: 2
 lt3a1~b*year12_child_feelingdisciplinechaos1+c*nc_chol_cog_noncog_corrected_FRC_1

 nc_chol_cog_noncog_corrected_FRC_1~nc_chol_cog_noncog_corrected_FRC_1
 
 # indrect and total effects between
          ab := a*b
          totalbw := ab + c
         
          # indrect and total effects within
          de := d*e
          totalwith := de + f "

messages.author: ac9e1459001ea58d
messages.subject: Re: 1-1-1 mediation model, no warnings, degree of -1, no p-value showing NA?
parts:
Hi Quan, 

There's a couple of oddities in your model specification, for example your level 2 model seems to be identical to the level 1 model. But specifically what's causing you not to get any p-values is that you are regressing a variable on itself: nc_chol_cog_noncog_corrected_FRC_1~nc_chol_cog_noncog_corrected_FRC_1

Good luck!

Best, 
Stijn
